integrity_statement: The general statement follows from the displayed analytic proof. Finite arbitrary-precision checks are corroborating only; the constant-gap edge factorization and leading confinement shift are acknowledged as prior work.
scientific_limitations: For each fixed nonnegative band index in the large-cell limit, at coupling equal to positive cell half-width. No uniform moving-index or full-quasimomentum-dispersion theorem is claimed; priority of an unlocated explicit two-term formula is not independently established.
title: Two-term bandwidth law for the constant-gap harmonic Kronig–Penney lattice
